# Visio 2010

Visio 2010 follows the [Fixed](/en-us/lifecycle/policies/fixed) Lifecycle Policy.

This applies to the following editions: Premium, Professional, Standard

Support dates are shown in the Pacific Time Zone (PT) - Redmond, WA, USA.

## Support Dates

| Listing | Start Date | Mainstream End Date | Extended End Date |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Visio 2010 | 7/15/2010 8:00:00 AM | 10/14/2015 6:59:59 AM | 10/14/2020 6:59:59 AM |

## Releases

| Version | Start Date | End Date |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Service Pack 2 | 7/19/2013 8:00:00 AM | 10/14/2020 6:59:59 AM |
| Service Pack 1 | 6/28/2011 8:00:00 AM | 10/15/2014 6:59:59 AM |
| Original Release | 7/15/2010 8:00:00 AM | 7/11/2012 6:59:59 AM |
